packageRules.description: The Dart SDK constraint follows from the Flutter pin (Flutter bundles Dart), so don't bump it separately.
Flutter SDK releases: the pin in pubspec.yaml's environment.flutter. Renovate regenerates pubspec.lock on the new version in the same PR.
realm_core and realm_firebase are pinned to the SAME enspyrco/realm commit; a half-bumped pair fails pub get, so they only ever move together.
